rules.title: San Francisco Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C – Relocation Payments
rules.requirement: Landlords evicting for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal from housing use, temporary capital improvement work or substantial rehabilitation must pay relocation amounts per tenant, capped per unit, with an additional amount for elderly, disabled or minor-child households. Ellis Act evictions carry separate, higher relocation amounts, adjusted each March 1.
rules.key_value: For notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27: $8,245 per tenant, max $24,733 per unit, plus $5,497 for each elderly/disabled tenant or household with minor child (Ellis Act: $11,110.05 per tenant, max $33,330.13, plus $7,443.90)

requires.name: eviction_ground
requires.text: Eviction based on owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal of unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, substantial rehabilitation, or Ellis Act withdrawal

exempt_if.name: short_capital_improvement
exempt_if.text: The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.

coverage.summary: Applies to San Francisco tenants served a notice of termination on the listed no-fault grounds.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Temporary capital improvement evictions under 20 days are governed by Civil Code Section 1947.9 instead.

rules.quoted_span: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
